title: Range bounds for bounded differences
statement: Let $W$ be a natural number and let $Z$ be a size specification for word width $W$. If $x,y\in\mathbb{Z}$ satisfy $|x|\le Z$'s word limit and $|y|\le Z$'s word limit, then both $x-y$ and $x-y-1$ satisfy $-2^W\le 2v<2^W$.
hypotheses_covered: $|x|$ is at most the word limit of $Z$
$|y|$ is at most the word limit of $Z$
